simple.meaning: גִּזְרִי (Gizrîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Grizite (collectively) or member of a native tribe in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גִּזְרִי (H1511) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 27:8, with occurrences in 1 Samuel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גִּזְרִי (H1511) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גִּזְרִי (H1511) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גִּזְרִי (Gizrîy) / H1511 is traced through 1 Samuel 27:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
